_scene: You are the cheerful narrator of a toddler's fire truck rescue video game, like a friendly fire-chief buddy talking to a 4-year-old. Playful, warm, energetic, clearly articulated, like a friendly kids' TV host. Short sentences with clear emotion.

s1.dir: Big announcing voice like a fire station alarm turning into a cheer, fast and excited, rising on 'ready!'.

s2.dir: Clear friendly instruction, medium pace, encouraging, slight emphasis on 'under'.

s3.dir: Playful sing-song, bouncy rhythm on 'bouncing', inviting.

s4.dir: A giggly 'Splash!' like getting splashed with water, then warm encouragement, no disappointment.

s5.dir: Proud quick cheer on 'Great aim!', then a punchy command 'Water on!'.

s6.dir: Relieved and happy, bright, a little stretched 'out!'.

s7.dir: Rising pitch like something going up, energetic and short.

s8.dir: Warm and proud, sweet, like a hug in a voice.

s9.dir: Fun playful instruction, voice goes down low on 'down' like squatting.

s10.dir: Excited anticipation, voice rises up high on 'up!'.

s11.dir: A big springy stretched 'Boooing!', then a delighted 'Nice catch!'.

s12.text: Hands up for the big splash!
s12.dir: Exciting build-up, clear instruction, rising on 'big splash!'.

s13.dir: Shout it like a party starting, super excited, stretched 'Suuuper'.

s14.dir: Proud and admiring, big warm smile, slower and grand.

s15.dir: Fresh and energetic, fast, like starting a new adventure.

s16.dir: Clear and firm but kind, slower pace, like a caring grown-up.

s17.dir: Relieved and bright, fast and happy, rising at the end.
